collection.name: client-disconnect-lab
collection.description: Slow backend for the client-disconnect-lab integration scenario (vnext#1258: a client that disconnects must not cancel a committed transition)

mocks.description: Answers after 8 s (mock-level delayMs; rules carry no delay, so a delayed response must be its own mock). The client-disconnect tests abort their HTTP call after 1 s, so the task is guaranteed to be in flight when the client goes away. MockLab matches by PREFIX: keep no other route under 'api/client-disconnect-lab/slow'. MockLab skips a collection whose name already exists, so a change here needs the container recreated (docker compose up -d --force-recreate mocklab, or down -v).
